doc.title: Jerome Richardson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996

title: Closing thanks
summary: Both thank each other and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been a fascinating hour.
I’m so glad, not only that you could come, but that I got to hear you play with that marvelous group.
Well I’m glad you came to hear the band. I’m really glad that you called me to do this. It’s really a worthy cause and I hope you got something out of it.
We certainly did. So on behalf of Hamilton College I’d like to thank Jerome Richardson for sharing your career.
